description: Frozen 20-node realization used by the archived Table 2 fitting workflow

generation.equation: single-constrained power-law gravity plus sinusoidal forcing and Gaussian noise

reproducibility_note: The frozen arrays are the source of truth for Table 2. The cleaned generator creates new realizations and is not expected to reproduce the archived Gaussian-noise stream bit for bit across PyTorch versions.
figure4_note: The trajectory used by the unchanged Figure 4 panel is a different archived realization with the same initial state and distance matrix. It is isolated under figure_sources/figure4 and must not be substituted for this Table 2 training bundle.
